notes.text: Decided to switch the team's planning from two-week sprints to a monthly cycle starting in January.
We'll repaint the living room a warm grey rather than white.
Contractor quote for the deck: about 7,800 dollars, two weeks of work, can start in May.
Garden: tomatoes did badly in the shady bed; move them to the south side next year.
Chose the 15-year fixed mortgage renewal over the variable rate.
Ideas for Maya's gift: a pottery class, a good chef's knife, or concert tickets.
The router keeps dropping connection in the evening; try changing the wifi channel.
Picked PostgreSQL over MongoDB for the inventory side project because the data is relational.
Car insurance renewal: current premium is 1,450 a year; get two other quotes before June.
Book club is reading The Remains of the Day next month.

documents.text:
# Apartment lease

## Rent
Monthly rent is 2,150 dollars, due on the first of each month. A late fee of 50 dollars applies after the fifth.

## Deposit
The security deposit is one month's rent and is returned within 30 days of move-out, minus documented damage.

## Pets
One cat or small dog is allowed with a pet deposit of 300 dollars.

## Ending the lease
Either party must give 60 days' written notice before the end of the term. The term ends on July 31.

## Maintenance
The tenant replaces light bulbs and furnace filters. The landlord handles appliances, plumbing and heating repairs.

# Employee handbook

## Vacation
Full-time employees get 20 days of paid vacation a year. Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year.

## Sick days
There are 10 paid sick days a year. A doctor's note is needed after three days in a row.

## Remote work
Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with their manager's approval.

## Expenses
Submit expense reports within 30 days with receipts. Meals while travelling are covered up to 75 dollars a day.

## Parental leave
The company tops up parental leave to 100 percent of salary for the first 16 weeks.

# Home insurance policy

## Coverage
The policy covers fire, theft, and water damage from burst pipes. Flooding from outside water is not covered.

## Deductible
The deductible is 1,000 dollars per claim.

## Making a claim
Report a claim within 72 hours by calling the claims line. Take photos of the damage before cleaning up.

## Valuables
Jewellery is covered up to 5,000 dollars unless it is listed separately on a rider.

# Q3 project report: inventory system

## Summary
The inventory system shipped to two warehouses in Q3. Order processing time fell from 4 minutes to 90 seconds.

## Risks
The barcode scanner vendor may discontinue the current model next year, which would require new hardware.

## Budget
The project spent 182,000 dollars against a budget of 200,000.

## Next quarter
Roll out to the remaining three warehouses and add low-stock alerts.

# Sourdough bread

## Starter
Feed the starter with equal weights of flour and water. It is ready when it doubles within 6 hours.

## Dough
Mix 500 g flour, 350 g water, 100 g starter and 10 g salt. Stretch and fold every 30 minutes for two hours.

## Proofing
Proof overnight in the fridge for 12 to 16 hours. Cold proofing gives a more sour flavour.

## Baking
Bake in a Dutch oven at 250 C with the lid on for 20 minutes, then 230 C uncovered for 25 minutes.
